settings.question: Does it work with Shopify's native B2B?
settings.answer: Yes. Shopify's native B2B (company profiles, catalogs, payment terms) is now included on every plan. Its built-in company request form is a single generic form with one file attachment and no review queue. B2B Onboarding & Wholesale adds the onboarding layer on top: custom application forms, an approval dashboard, buyer documents with expiration tracking, and approvals that create the Shopify company, contact, location, tax and payment terms in one step. It also keeps records in sync with Shopify company updates and can import your existing Shopify B2B companies.

settings.question: Do I need Shopify Plus?
settings.answer: No. The app works on any Shopify plan. Wholesale customers log in to your existing store, see their tailored pricing, and check out through the standard Shopify checkout, no Plus features required.

settings.question: How does wholesale onboarding work?
settings.answer: Publish a sign-up form built with the drag-and-drop form builder, collecting the business details and documents you need. Applications land in the approval dashboard, where you approve or reject in one click and get email notifications when new applications arrive. Approved buyers are assigned to a discount tier and can start ordering immediately.

settings.question: How do customers get their wholesale pricing?
settings.answer: Customers simply log in to your store. Their customer group determines what they see: percentage discounts, variant-level price lists, and volume breaks, applied on your normal storefront and through the standard Shopify checkout. There is no separate wholesale storefront to maintain.

settings.question: Can I migrate existing wholesale customers?
settings.answer: Yes. You can bulk-assign existing customers to discount tiers, and there are guided migrations for stores coming from Shopify's native B2B or from other wholesale apps like Wholesale Gorilla. See the migration guides in the documentation.

settings.question: How much does it cost?
settings.answer: There's a free plan for up to 10 wholesale companies. Grow is $29/month for up to 250 companies and adds buyer document uploads; Pro is $99/month with unlimited companies, document expirations and renewal alerts, and priority support. Paid plans have a 21-day free trial. See the Shopify App Store listing for current pricing.
